    # Duplicates should be ignored (unique values only)

    assert next_smallest([3, 3, 3, 1, 1, 5, 5]) == 3
    # Negative numbers
    assert next_smallest([-5, -1, -3, -2]) == -3
    assert next_smallest([-2, -4, -6]) == -4

    # Empty list -> None

    # Two unique values

    # Floats
